name: Mist Veil's Lockbox
summary: Off Darkshore, Mist Veil's Lockbox lies in the sunken night elven vessel. It holds the captain's log and personal effects, lost when coastal murlocs ambushed and sank the ship.

sections.title: Lost to the Depths
sections.body: The night elven vessel Mist Veil sank while sailing toward Auberdine. Coastal murlocs ambushed it alongside its sister ship, the Silver Dawning, and overwhelmed both vessels. The captain perished in the attack. Their logbook and personal belongings remain sealed in the lockbox in the flooded hold, surrounded by murlocs.

sections.title: Rest for the Crew
sections.body: Surviving sailors reached Auberdine, but the loss of their vessel and commander still grieves them. Gorbold Steelhand seeks Mist Veil's Lockbox so the captain's final effects can be honored and laid to rest. Recovering it from the flooded wreck may bring some solace to the survivors on the mainland.

faq.q: What is inside Mist Veil's Lockbox?
faq.answer: Mist Veil's Lockbox holds the captain's log and personal effects. The captain perished when the ship sank, and the surviving crew in Auberdine want these mementos returned to honor their fallen leader.

faq.q: How did the Mist Veil sink?
aliases: what happened to the mist veil
faq.answer: Coastal murlocs ambushed Mist Veil while it sailed toward Auberdine. They overwhelmed the ship, which sank alongside its sister vessel, the Silver Dawning.
The lockbox lies underwater off Darkshore, north of Auberdine, in the flooded hull of the sunken Mist Veil. Murlocs fill the wreck.
Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine seeks the lockbox for the surviving crew, hoping to honor the fallen captain and bring them peace.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can help return the fallen captain's logbook and lay their spirit to rest in the waters off Darkshore.
As an Alliance member, you can honor the fallen crew and help the maritime community in Auberdine.
